channel.title: Clickdy News
channel.description: Fresh AI, tech and gadget news from Clickdy.

item.title: Millat and China's XDAO Partner for Electric Motorcycles
item.description: Millat Industrial Products Limited has partnered with China's XDAO to boost electric motorcycle localization in Pakistan.

item.title: Denmark National Population Database Breached Using Simple Password
item.description: A hacker accessed Denmark's national population database containing data on 8.8 million people by using the weak password '123456'.

item.title: Drupal Fixes Critical Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
item.description: Drupal has released security updates to patch a critical remote code execution vulnerability in its Field UI module involving contributed modules.

item.title: Amazon-owned Bee unveils two personal AI devices
item.description: Bee has released its first AI hardware under Amazon, introducing an updated wearable and a card-sized smartphone recorder starting at $75.

item.title: Volvo Expands Nvidia Partnership for Automated Driving
item.description: Volvo is broadening its long-standing collaboration with Nvidia to enhance its automated driving systems across more vehicle types.

item.title: FBR Extends Tax Return Deadline for 2026
item.description: The Federal Board of Revenue has announced another extension for filing income tax returns.

item.title: Malicious Packages Discovered on Arch User Repository
item.description: Fake helper tools on the Arch User Repository attempt to push malware with root privileges.

item.title: Collabora RCE Flaw Exploited to Backdoor Nextcloud Servers
item.description: Threat actors are actively exploiting a critical remote code execution vulnerability in a Nextcloud server application to install backdoors.

item.title: Critical Linux Kernel PwnEscape Flaw Exposes Host Memory
item.description: A critical Linux kernel vulnerability dubbed PwnEscape allows virtual machines to read host computer memory.

item.title: New York Congressman Proposes Bill to Protect Video Game Ownership
item.description: Representative Ritchie Torres plans to introduce legislation urging the FTC to establish rules ensuring consumers can keep playing purchased video games.

item.title: Meta releases Muse Spark Open model for Apple silicon
item.description: Meta has introduced Muse Spark Open, a new open-weight AI model designed to run locally on Mac computers.

item.title: Cal AI Achieves Viral Success Through Influencer Marketing
item.description: Cal AI generated over $30 million in revenue within two years before being acquired by MyFitness.

item.title: Intero Biosystems Wins Startup Battlefield at Disrupt 2026
item.description: Intero Biosystems won the $100,000 grand prize at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 after competing against 199 other companies.

item.title: UK to ban pornography depicting choking and incest
item.description: The government announces a ban on specific types of adult content starting in early November following a review.

item.title: Steam Introduces Achievement Sets for Base Games and DLCs
item.description: Valve is rolling out achievement sets on Steam, allowing developers to group achievements separately for base games and downloadable content.

item.title: Tesla Demonstrates Next-Generation Roadster in Texas
item.description: Tesla showcased its next-generation Roadster in Waco, Texas, featuring rapid acceleration and unique driving capabilities.

item.title: Tesla shows Roadster with SpaceX thrusters in Texas
item.description: Tesla demonstrated a new Roadster featuring SpaceX thrusters, using them to leap over multiple company vehicles.

item.title: ChatGPT Google Chrome extension gains tab-viewing features
item.description: OpenAI has updated its ChatGPT Google Chrome extension to let the AI view your currently open browser tabs.

item.title: KDE Celebrates 30th Anniversary with Plasma 6.8 Release
item.description: KDE marks its 30th anniversary by launching Plasma 6.8, introducing remote upgrades, an accompanying movie, and saying goodbye to X11.

item.title: Pakistan Ranks Second-Worst for Hunger in South Asia
item.description: The 2026 Global Hunger Index places Pakistan behind only Afghanistan for the highest hunger score in the region.

item.title: Punjab E-Bike Scheme Distribution Date Announced
item.description: The Punjab government has announced details regarding the distribution of electric bikes to students under a provincial scheme.

item.title: Minors Bypass Restrictions as Social Media Bans Expand
item.description: Governments push to restrict social media access for minors, while children continue to find ways around the implemented rules.

item.title: China-Linked Hackers Exploit BeyondTrust Zero-Day
item.description: A China-nexus cyber espionage group exploited a BeyondTrust Remote Support zero-day vulnerability in late August 2026.

item.title: Punjab Schools Face Two-Month Payment Delay
item.description: Thousands of schools under the Punjab Education Initiatives Management Authority are experiencing financial difficulties due to delayed payments.

item.title: Chicago Police Assisted HSI Surveillance of Activists
item.description: Local police near Chicago helped federal agents track Minnesota anti-ICE activists, despite state sanctuary laws.

item.title: Australia Proposes Off Switch for Social Media Algorithms
item.description: Australia introduces a proposal requiring social media platforms to give users the option to turn off recommended content.

item.title: India Reports Rogue AI Agent Activity
item.description: India has become the latest nation to experience rogue AI agent activity, driven by exposed credentials and connection settings.

item.title: OpenBSD Root Exploit Chains 37-Year-Old Bug
item.description: Security researchers demonstrate a local privilege escalation exploit gaining root on OpenBSD by chaining an old integer overflow with a kernel flaw.

item.title: The Leap Second Has Been Officially Abolished
item.description: Leap seconds, which have caused years of debate among timekeeping experts, have now been officially eliminated.

item.title: Replit Ends Its Partnership With Anthropic, CEO Confirms
item.description: Replit has stopped working with Anthropic due to various factors, including cost, according to the company's CEO.
